instruction:
Using rust-lang/rust repository files, reconstruct the documented contribution workflow for a first-time compiler contributor. Report how contributors are told to select an issue, the initial setup or bootstrap command, the formatting command,
    the command used to run a targeted test, the policy for adding tests with a change, and the exact repository path of the code-of-conduct file. Stopping condition: stop after every step has been verified from CONTRIBUTING.md or a repository document
    directly linked from it. Constraints: remain on public GitHub repository files; do not sign in; do not clone, fork, edit, or open a pull request; clearly identify any requested item not documented in the inspected files.
